evals.name: inventory-contract-skills
evals.prompt: what skills do i have for working with contracts and agreements? group them somehow so i can see what's what. don't actually run any of them
evals.expected_output: A grouped inventory of contract-related skills with exact invocable names, no skills invoked.

evals.name: plan-chart-to-deck
evals.prompt: I want to take the per-town revenue numbers in data/towns.json, make a chart of the top 10 towns, and put it in a 5-slide deck for our town council meeting next week. Which skills should I use and in what order? Just give me the plan for now, don't build anything yet.
evals.expected_output: A short ordered plan naming dataviz (built-in) then a slides skill (pptx or similar), with the handoff between them; nothing built.

evals.name: review-then-council-summary
evals.prompt: Our town is about to sign this license-plate camera contract with Flock: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-town-bookkeeping--/c048721a-55ef-5e30-bc58-16a3b8be2e0f/scratchpad/skill-index-orchestrator-workspace/fixtures/flock-alpr-agreement.md . Review it for problems and then write a plain-English summary the town council can read in 2 minutes.
evals.expected_output: A contract review flagging auto-renewal, 7% escalator, perpetual data license, default sharing, liability cap, customer indemnity, termination fees, Georgia law; plus a short non-legal council summary. Ideally produced via a contract-review skill then a stakeholder-summary skill.
